$comment: Violet Hour palette -- the ONE place colors are defined. Edit a hex here, then `npm run build` (build-theme.js + contrast-check.js). Every value was solved against the contrast rules rather than picked by eye; scripts/ has the solvers. Original work: no colors are derived from another theme.

$design.concept: The violet hour -- the half-hour after sunset. A deep violet field (hue 261-272, never gray, never black), cool sky colors for structure, and the last warm light of the day for literals.

hues.neutrals: 261-272 violet, saturation eased from 0.34 down to 0.25 as surfaces lighten so chrome never turns lurid
hues.identity: 262 lavender -- accent, focus, links, function names
hues.coolSky: 136 green (regex, attributes), 156 mint (template punctuation), 172 aqua (types AND intrinsic tags - deliberately one colour, an intrinsic element is a type-like thing), 206 sky (properties, git-modified)
hues.cssPlan: selector 46 gold, property 206 sky, value-keyword 156 mint, unit/number 14 coral - four well-separated hues, so no two frequent CSS tokens blur
